name: Email Settings
description: Account configuration, Vault references, locks, and scan state

agentPrompts.label: Add or update a mailbox account
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-email` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then create or update the `busa-email-config` record with the non-secret account details I give — mailbox address, aliases, IMAP/SMTP host/port/security, folders, mailbox group, and outbound identities. Never write secret values here; name the Vault reference instead and tell me which Vault keys still need to be added.

agentPrompts.label: Is my mailbox setup ready to scan?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-email` skill in this folder, then check whether the Folder, Reviews/Contacts/Settings Bases, and Drive exist, whether Email Settings has a configured mailbox, and whether every IMAP/SMTP endpoint names a resolvable Vault reference. Tell me exactly what is missing, if anything.
